program:
app "Fuel gauge" bolt ocean
setting budget money = 50000 "Monthly budget"
table spend amount money, note text
let used = sum(spend.amount month)
let left = budget - used
let frac = clamp(left / budget, 0, 1)
draw 100, 60 width 240 middle
  arc 50, 55, 40, 270, 450 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 50, 55, 40, 270, 270 + 180 * frac stroke accent thick 8
  line 50, 55, 50 + 34 * sin(-90 + 180 * frac), 55 - 34 * cos(-90 + 180 * frac) stroke ink thick 2
  label 50, 50, left big
stat used, "burned this month"
"Remaining of" budget faint align center
form spend, "Add spend"
list spend by day
describe:
Fuel gauge, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- spend: amount: money; note: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 50000.
Works out:
- used is the total amount of spend this month.
- left is budget minus used.
- frac is left divided by budget kept between 0 and 1.
Shows:
- a drawing made of arcs, lines, labels.
- a big number: used, labelled "burned this month".
- text: "Remaining of", budget.
- a form to add a spend.

request: BMI for the gym members i train, height in feet and inches, weight in kg

checklist.item: inputs for height in feet and inches and weight in kg
shows BMI number
shows a category such as normal or overweight

program:
app "BMI" scale ocean
state ft num = 5
state inch num = 8
state kg num = 70
let m = (ft * 12 + inch) * 0.0254
let bmi = kg / (m * m)
let cat = if(bmi < 18.5, "Underweight", if(bmi < 25, "Normal", if(bmi < 30, "Overweight", "Obese")))
stack card gap 2
  field ft "Height (feet)"
  field inch "Height (inches)"
  field kg "Weight (kg)"
stat fixed(bmi, 1), "BMI"
text cat head color if(bmi >= 18.5 and bmi < 25, good, warn)
describe:
BMI, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- m is the result of ft times 12 plus inch times 0.0254.
- bmi is kg divided by the result of m times m.
- cat is "Underweight" when bmi is less than 18.5, otherwise "Normal" when bmi is less than 25, otherwise "Overweight" when bmi is less than 30, otherwise "Obese".
Remembers while you use it: ft, starting at 5; inch, starting at 8; kg, starting at 70.
Shows:
- a box to fill in ft, labelled "Height (feet)".
- a box to fill in inch, labelled "Height (inches)".
- a box to fill in kg, labelled "Weight (kg)".
- a big number: the fixed of bmi, labelled "BMI".
- text: cat.

request: pomodoro 25/5 with a long break after 4

checklist.item: 25 minute work timer
5 minute break
long break after 4 rounds
shows round count
start and pause buttons

program:
app "Pomodoro" timer ink
state phase pick Work|Break|Long = Work
state round num = 1
state held dur = 25m
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
when going and phase = Work and round < 4 and now >= ends set phase = Break then set ends = now + 5m then notify "Break time"
when going and phase = Work and round >= 4 and now >= ends set phase = Long then set ends = now + 15m then notify "Long break"
when going and phase = Break and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = round + 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "Back to work"
when going and phase = Long and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "New cycle"
"Round" round "of 4" head align center
text phase color if(phase = Work, accent, good) align center
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), held) huge align center
row gap 1
  if going
    button "Pause" tap set held = ends - now then set going = no
  else
    button "Start" tap set ends = now + held then set going = yes
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set held = 25m
describe:
Pomodoro, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: phase, starting at Work; round, starting at 1; held, starting at 25 minutes; ends, starting at now; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- when going and phase is Work and round is less than 4 and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Break, then sets ends to now plus 5 minutes, then shows the notice "Break time".
- when going and phase is Work and round is at least 4 and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Long, then sets ends to now plus 15 minutes, then shows the notice "Long break".
- when going and phase is Break and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Work, then sets round to round plus 1, then sets ends to now plus 25 minutes, then shows the notice "Back to work".
- when going and phase is Long and now is at least ends, it sets phase to Work, then sets round to 1, then sets ends to now plus 25 minutes, then shows the notice "New cycle".
- text: "Round", round, "of 4".
- text: phase.
- text: the larger of ends minus now and 0 hours when going, otherwise held.
- if going:
  - a button "Pause"; a tap sets held to ends minus now, then sets going to no.
- otherwise:
  - a button "Start"; a tap sets ends to now plus held, then sets going to yes.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets phase to Work, then sets round to 1, then sets held to 25 minutes.

request: trip fuel cost split. distance km, car km per litre, petrol price, number of people sharing

computes total fuel cost
computes cost per person

program:
app "Trip fuel split" car ocean
state dist num = 300
state kmpl num = 12
state price money = 270
state people num = 4
state round bool = no
stack card gap 2
  field dist "Distance (km)"
  field kmpl "Car km per litre"
  field price "Petrol price per litre"
  field people "People sharing"
  "Round trip" faint
  toggle round
let km = dist * if(round, 2, 1)
let cost = km / kmpl * price

stat cost / people, "per person"
"Distance driven" km "km," fixed(km / kmpl, 1) "litres" faint
describe:
Trip fuel split, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- km is dist times 2 when round, otherwise 1.
- cost is km divided by kmpl times price.
Remembers while you use it: dist, starting at 300; kmpl, starting at 12; price, starting at 270; people, starting at 4; round, starting at no.
Shows:

- a box to fill in kmpl, labelled "Car km per litre".
- a box to fill in price, labelled "Petrol price per litre".
- a box to fill in people, labelled "People sharing".
- text: "Round trip".
- a tick box for round.
- a big number: cost, labelled "total fuel cost".
- a big number: cost divided by people, labelled "per person".
- text: "Distance driven", km, "km,", the fixed of km divided by kmpl, "litres".

request: add a 3rd team, Team C. and a button to reset everything

program:
app "Carrom" game ink
table point team pick A|B|C, n num 1..9 = 1
table board
let sa = sum(point.n where team = A)
let sb = sum(point.n where team = B)
let sc = sum(point.n where team = C)
row gap 2
  stack align center grow
    "Team A" bold
    sa huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = A, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = A, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = A, n = 3
  stack align center grow
    "Team B" bold
    sb huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = B, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = B, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = B, n = 3
  stack align center grow
    "Team C" bold
    sc huge
    row gap 1
      button "+1" tap add point team = C, n = 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = C, n = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = C, n = 3
"Boards played:" count(board) big
row gap 1
  button "Undo last point" tap remove last(point)
  button "New board" tap add board then remove all point
  button "Reset everything" tap remove all point then remove all board
describe:
Carrom, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of A, B, C; n: number, 1 to 9, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- board: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- sa is the total n of point where team is A.
- sb is the total n of point where team is B.

Shows:

- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to B, n set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to B, n set to 3.
- text: "Team C".

- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to C, n set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to C, n set to 3.
